title: BMI and fasting glucose in the NHANES fasting subsample
researchQuestion: Among NHANES adults in the morning fasting laboratory subsample, what is the adjusted association between body mass index and fasting plasma glucose?

description: Adults aged 20 years and older with fasting laboratory subsample eligibility

definitions: Continuous fasting plasma glucose from LBXGLU.
Continuous body mass index from BMXBMI.
Complete-case survey-weighted association using the fasting laboratory subsample weight.

surveyDesign.weightRationale: LBXGLU fasting plasma glucose is measured in the morning fasting laboratory subsample, so WTSAF2YR is the least-common-denominator NHANES weight for this AnalysisSpec.
surveyDesign.eligibilityNote: Interpret estimates for fasting subsample-eligible adults with nonmissing fasting glucose, BMI, covariates, strata, PSU, and positive WTSAF2YR.
